components.name: site-header
behaviors: Contains site logo (fictional), skip link, location search form
Always visible at top of viewport
Contains demo premium banner (non‑functional) as an intentional addition
keyboard_expectations: Skip link is first focusable element and visible on focus
Location search input and button are reachable via Tab
All header links are focusable in DOM order

components.name: primary-nav
behaviors: Horizontal list of links to major site sections
Current page indicated by aria-current="page" where applicable
keyboard_expectations: Each link is focusable via Tab
Enter activates link

components.name: site-footer
behaviors: Contains copyright notice, fictional brand name, and links to Help/About
keyboard_expectations: Links are focusable via Tab

components.name: location-search
behaviors: Text input for location entry
Button to submit search (demo)
On submit shows a demo alert (no real lookup)
keyboard_expectations: Input receives focus via Tab
Button reachable via Tab, activates on Enter or Space
Escape closes any demo alert (if implemented)

components.name: forecast-tabs
behaviors: ARIA tablist with tabs for Today, Hourly, 10‑Day, Monthly
Shows associated tabpanel when tab selected
Persists active tab in localStorage (demo only)
keyboard_expectations: Tab list is reachable via Tab
Left/Right arrow moves focus between tabs
Tab or Enter activates selected tab
Home/End move to first/last tab
Tabpanel receives focus when activated

components.name: unit-toggle
behaviors: Button toggles label between °C and °F
Demo only – no actual temperature conversion performed
keyboard_expectations: Button focusable via Tab
Space or Enter toggles state
aria‑changed reflects pressed state

components.name: radar-placeholder
behaviors: Static SVG representing radar returns with title and description
Non‑functional Refresh button
keyboard_expectations: SVG is focusable (if tabindex added) – not required as it is decorative
Button focusable via Tab, activates on Enter/Space

components.name: alert-filters
behaviors: Checkbox group for alert type selection
When any checkbox checked, a demo alert banner appears
Banner dismissible via close button
keyboard_expectations: Each checkbox reachable via Tab
Space toggles checked state
When state changes, alert banner visibility updates
Close button focusable via Tab, activates on Enter/Space

components.name: news-card
behaviors: Displays a weather news item with title, summary, timestamp
keyboard_expectations: Article is focusable if made interactive (not required)
Any links inside would be reachable via Tab

components.name: login-form
behaviors: Email and password fields with client‑side validation
On submit shows demo success or error message
Form resets after successful demo login
keyboard_expectations: Each input reachable via Tab
Submit button reachable via Tab, activates on Enter
Error messages are live‑region announced
Success message receives focus after submit

components.name: pollen-indicator
behaviors: Shows pollen level (low/moderate/high) for tree, grass, weed for each day using colored blocks
keyboard_expectations: Blocks are decorative; no keyboard interaction expected
If made focusable, would receive focus via Tab

components.name: hero
behaviors: Contains page heading and introductory text or forecast summary
keyboard_expectations: Heading is perceivable by screen readers
Any links inside are reachable via Tab

components.name: demo-premium-banner
behaviors: Non‑functional banner indicating demo premium upsell
Clearly labeled as demo and not functional
keyboard_expectations: Banner is not interactive; no keyboard expectations
